title_zh: 约定向插画作者询问转载许可

scenario.label_zh: 约定向插画作者询问转载许可
scenario.goal_zh: 确认署名不能替代版权许可，并分工索取杂志转载所需的明确授权

context_zh: 社区杂志编辑和专栏作者准备一篇文章，还未获得插画转载许可。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: As the gardening columnist, I'd love to use that drawing beside my next article.

sentences.speaker: Editor
sentences.text: Do you know who the creator is?

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Yes, Lin, a regular contributor to the local arts newsletter. I'd put her name under it.

sentences.speaker: Editor
sentences.text: Credit is important, but it does not itself give us permission. Who owns the copyright?

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: I don't know. I'll ask Lin whether she holds it and whether she can license this use.

sentences.speaker: Editor
sentences.text: Please specify our printed magazine and online edition. I'll send you the image size and the planned publication date to include in the request.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Good. We won't place the drawing in either edition until that is clear.
